info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Business Direction Continuity Plannings-spec
info.description: The Business Direction Continuity Planning API provides access to critical information regarding organizational continuity strategies in the banking sector. This API enables users to retrieve detailed lists of business direction continuity plans, ensuring that organizations can maintain operational effectiveness during disruptions. Typical consumers include risk management teams, compliance officers, and senior management seeking to review or analyze continuity strategies. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their preparedness and resilience against potential threats.

get.summary: Retrieve continuity planning information for business directions.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information regarding continuity planning within business directions, providing insights and guidelines necessary to ensure sustained operations during unforeseen circumstances.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a GET request for the business direction's continuity planning operations. It is essential to provide the required parameters as defined in the schema to ensure a successful response.

200.description: Successful retrieval of continuity planning information.

ListBusinessDirectionContinuityPlannings.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to business direction's continuity planning in operations.

items.description: List of initiatives related to business continuity planning.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which requires a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) to be included in the Authorization header of requests. The token should be generated by a reliable authentication server and must be provided in the format: 'Bearer {token}'.
